issues.issue: Whether the claimant is excludable under Article 1F(b) for serious non-political crimes outside Canada
issues.result_text: Claimant committed serious crimes in the USA before entering Canada; Article 1F(b) threshold met.

issues.issue: Whether the US convictions were serious, fairly obtained and non-political
issues.result_text: Convictions were fair, offences serious and non-political; claimant is excludable.
